organization.officialName: East Kootenay Community Health Services Society
organization.description: Community health services society, registered on 13 March 1997 (S0036594), serving the areas of several community health councils where no regional board was formed. On 12 December 2001 its governors were replaced by the new authority's appointees (M298-M305/2001) and its services passed to the Interior Health Authority. The corporate registry records its dissolution on 15 February 2002. It is not in Schedule A of B.C. Reg. 293/2001, so this is a passing of services, not an amalgamation; how and when its assets were conveyed is not found.

organization.officialName: Upper Island/Central Coast Community Health Services Society
organization.description: Community health services society, registered on 13 March 1997 (S0036595), serving the areas of several community health councils where no regional board was formed. On 12 December 2001 its governors were replaced by the new authority's appointees (M298-M305/2001) and its services passed to the Vancouver Island Health Authority. Its Central Coast territory moved to Vancouver Coastal in March 2002. The corporate registry records its dissolution on 15 February 2002. It is not in Schedule A of B.C. Community health services society, registered on 13 March 1997 (S0036598), serving the areas of several community health councils where no regional board was formed. On 12 December 2001 its governors were replaced by the new authority's appointees (M298-M305/2001) and its services passed to the Interior Health Authority and the Northern Health Authority. Its territory was split: the Quesnel council went to Northern Health, the others to Interior Health; Bella Coola moved on to Vancouver Coastal in March 2002. The corporate registry records its dissolution on 15 February 2002. It is not in Schedule A of B.C. Reg. 293/2001, so this is a passing of services, not an amalgamation; how and when its assets were conveyed is not found.
